records.title: Quantifying Depth Sufficiency in Residual Neural Networks: A First-Order Criterion
records.reason: The paper proposes a first-order criterion for whether residual depth growth could improve a network, evaluated on ResNets and GPT-style checkpoints. It is a training-time diagnostic, not demonstrated layer pruning or LLM inference optimization.

records.title: Recent developments in Transformer inference deployment on FPGA platforms: A survey
records.reason: This primary source is a systematic survey of Transformer inference deployment on FPGAs, organizing model/compiler/architecture/runtime trade-offs. It is useful serving background but reports no new method or original deployment result.
